# couchbase-capella-aidp_provider (Data Source)

Retrieves an AI Data Plane provider integration by organization and provider ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "couchbase-capella-aidp_provider" "example" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  id              = var.provider_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the AI Data Plane provider integration.
- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Attributes) Couchbase audit data for the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `configuration` (String) JSON object containing the provider-specific configuration.
- `name` (String) The name of the provider integration.
- `type` (String) The type of provider. One of `awsS3`, `openAI`, `awsBedrock`.

<a id="nestedatt--audit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `audit`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The RFC3339 timestamp when the resource was created.
- `created_by` (String) The user who created the resource.
- `modified_at` (String) The RFC3339 timestamp when the resource was last modified.
- `modified_by` (String) The user who last modified the resource.
- `version` (Number) The version of the resource.
